facts.statement: The SC Marketplace had a Summertime sale of 'fabulous deals' around early July 2009, promoted for the 4th of July.
facts.quote: Some fabulous deals just hit the SC Marketplace!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A short official news post announcing the Summertime Marketplace Sale on the SC (Subscriber Currency) Marketplace, which offered an Uncle Sam suit and a Fireworks Crate for the 4th of July. The post gives no prices, dates for the end of the sale, or item details. The date is inferred from the capture date and the relative 'Posted 3 days, 23 hours ago' stamp.
